buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

Buyer Added Text Based ATC Clauses 1. Office of Bidder in Delhi : The bidder must have a functional office located in Delhi, which shall remain operational in Delhi during the entire currency of the contract. The bidder shall upload doc umentary evidence in support of the same in the form of any one of the following documents: (i) Electricity Bill / Landline/ Broadband Bill (last three months); or (ii) Income Tax Return (ITR); or (iii) GST Return; or (iv) Valid Rent Agreement/Lease Agreement. 2. Undertaking regarding Insolvency/Liquidation and Blacklisting: The bidder shall upload th e following undertaking on its company letterhead, duly signed by the authorised signatory. The d ate of the undertaking must fall within the bid submission period. < Letterhead of the Bidder> UNDERTAKING REGARDING INSOLVENCY / LIQUIDATION AND BLACKLISTING Date: ______________ We hereby certify and undertake that: 1. M/s __________________________________________ is not under liquidation, court receivership, insolvenc y proceedings, bankrupt, or under any similar proceeding as on the date of submission of the bid. 2. M/s __________________________________________ has not been blacklisted, debarred, or barred from p articipation in tendering by any Central Government Department, State Government Department, Public S ector Undertaking (PSU), Autonomous Body, or any Government Organisation during the last five years or from the date of its establishment, whichever is less, as on the date of submission of the bid. 3. We hereby declare that the above information is true and correct to the best of our knowledge. We understand that any misrepresentation or concealment of facts may render our bid liable for rejection and may attract action as per the applicable terms and conditions of the tender. For M/s __________________________________ Signature of Authorised Signatory: ____________ Name: ___________________________________ Designation: ______________________________ 3. EPFO / ESIC Registration Certificates: The bidder shall upload copies of its valid EPFO (Emplo yees' Provident Fund Organisation) and ESIC (Employees' State Insurance Corporation) registration certificates along with the bid. 4. Restriction on Assignment/Subletting of Contract : The service provider shall not assign, tra nsfer, sublet, or otherwise part with the contract, either wholly or partially, without obtaining prior written permission from this office. 5. Extension of Contract : The contract may be extended for a further period of up to two years o n half yearly or yearly basis, subject to mutual consent of both parties and satisfactory performanc e of the service provider. 6. Termination of Contract : This office reserves the right to cancel or terminate the contract at a ny time during the currency of the contract by giving one month’s notice to the service provider, w ithout assigning any reason. 7. Variation in Quantity/Manpower Requirement : This office reserves the right to increase or d ecrease the required manpower during the currency of the contract by up to 25% of the total bid q uantity at the contracted rates. The service provider shall be bound to provide manpower accordin gly. 8. Deployment of Sweepers at Office Locations : The required deployment of manpower at vari ous office locations is as under: S.No Location Sweeper required Total (M + F) 1 2/A Mansingh Road, New Delhi 20 (16 + 4)

2 West Block-I(Ground Floor, 1st Floor & 2nd Floor), R. K. Puram, 08 (6 + 2) New Delhi 3 Sewa Bhawan (1st Floor), R. K. Puram, New Delhi 04 (3 + 1) 4 National Data Centre, 8th Floor, IT Park, DMRC building, Delhi 07 (5 + 2) Shastri Park, Delhi 39 (30+9) The deployment of male/female sweepers may be changed by this office as per requirement during the cu rrency of the contract, and the service provider shall comply accordingly. 9. Availability of Manpower on Payroll : The bidder shall have at least 50% of the required manpower proposed for deployment under this contract on its payroll for a minimum period of one year prior to the d ate of submission of bid. The bidder shall upload an undertaking on its letterhead, duly signed by the auth orised signatory, in the following format. The date of the undertaking must fall within the bid submission p eriod. The bidder shall also upload supporting documentary evidence such as EPF records, ESIC records or bank statement for salary disbursal for verification. This requirement shall be relaxed for Micro and Small E nterprises (MSEs) and Startups, subject to submission of valid documentary proof of such status. < Letterhead of the Bidder> UNDERTAKING REGARDING AVAILABILITY OF MANPOWER ON PAYROLL Date: ______________ It is certified that at least 50% of the required manpower proposed for deployment under this contr act has been on the payroll of M/s __________________________ for a minimum period of one year prior to the date of submission of bid. For M/s __________________________________ Signature of Authorised Signatory: ____________ Name: ___________________________________ Designation: ______________________________ 10. Payment of Wages : The service provider shall first disburse salaries/wages to the contracted st aff deployed under the contract from its own funds by 10th of every month and thereafter claim rei mbursement/payment from this office. The bill submitted by the service provider shall invariably b e accompanied by the following documents: (i) EPF contribution details; (ii) ESIC contribution details; (iii) Bank statement showing transfer of wages to deployed staff; and (iv) Any other document required under applicable rules. 11. Rejection of Incomplete Bids : The bid shall be liable for rejection if the bidder fails to upload c ertificates, undertaking, declaration, supporting document or any other document sought under th e Bid Document, ATC, or Corrigendum, if any. .
